tools.name: list_projects

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a project by ID.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update an existing project (PUT).

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project by ID.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search projects by filter.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: list_work_items
tools.description: List work items (test cases, checklists, shared steps) of a project, with optional filters.

name.description: Filter by (part of) work item name.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: search_work_items
tools.description: Search work items across projects. Typed filter fields are combined with an optional raw "filter" object (TestIT WorkItemFilterApiModel) for advanced fields.

nameOrId.description: Work item name part or global ID.

name.description: Filter by (part of) work item name.

filter.description: Raw WorkItemFilterApiModel fields (e.g. createdDate, attributes, autoTestIds).

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_work_item
tools.description: Get a work item by ID (UUID).

tools.name: create_work_item
tools.description: Create a test case, checklist or shared step. Defaults: entityTypeName=TestCases, state=NotReady, priority=Medium, duration=60000 ms (always 0 for SharedSteps — required by TestIT). Extra CreateWorkItemApiModel fields can be passed in "payload".

workItemId.description: Shared step UUID to reference instead of an action.
Shared step UUID to reference instead of an action.
Shared step UUID to reference instead of an action.

payload.description: Raw CreateWorkItemApiModel fields; typed args take precedence.

tools.name: update_work_item
tools.description: Update an existing work item.

tools.name: delete_work_item
tools.description: Delete a work item by ID (UUID).

tools.name: get_work_item_history
tools.description: Get work item history.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_work_item_versions
tools.description: Get all versions of a work item.

tools.name: restore_work_item
tools.description: Restore an archived (deleted) work item by ID.

tools.name: purge_work_item
tools.description: Permanently delete an archived work item. Irreversible; the item must be deleted (archived) first.

tools.name: upload_work_item_attachment
tools.description: Upload an attachment to a work item.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List all sections (folders) of a project as a flat list with parentId. The root section has parentId=null. Use section IDs as sectionId when creating work items.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Get a section with its precondition/postcondition steps.

isDeleted.description: Set true to read an archived section.

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a section. parentId defaults to the project's root section (TestIT rejects parentId=null).

tools.name: rename_section
tools.description: Rename a section.

tools.name: move_section
tools.description: Move a section (with its work items and subsections) under another parent. Optionally place it before nextSectionId.

tools.name: delete_section
tools.description: Delete (archive) a section together with its subsections and work items.

tools.name: list_test_runs
tools.description: List test runs for a project.

testPlanId.description: Only runs of this test plan.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_test_run
tools.description: Get a test run by ID.

tools.name: create_test_run
tools.description: Create an empty test run in a project (state NotStarted). Extra CreateEmptyTestRunApiModel fields (attachments, links) can be passed in "payload".

launchSource.description: Free-form launch source, e.g. CI job URL.

tools.name: start_test_run
tools.description: Start a test run.

tools.name: stop_test_run
tools.description: Stop a test run.

tools.name: create_test_run_from_work_items
tools.description: Create a test run inside a test plan for the given work items x configurations (the plan becomes InProgress). Only AUTOMATED work items are accepted (linked to an autotest, see link_autotest_work_item); TestIT rejects manual ones. Results are pre-created and filled via submit_test_run_results; the run completes when all results are in.

tools.name: complete_test_run
tools.description: Complete a test run (InProgress/Stopped -> Completed).

tools.name: delete_test_run
tools.description: Delete (archive) a test run by ID. Use restore_test_run to undo or purge_test_run to remove permanently.

tools.name: restore_test_run
tools.description: Restore an archived (deleted) test run.

tools.name: purge_test_run
tools.description: Permanently delete an archived test run. Irreversible; delete (archive) it first.

tools.name: get_test_run_results
tools.description: Get test results for a test run.

tools.name: get_test_result
tools.description: Get a test result by ID.

tools.name: search_test_results
tools.description: Search test results. Typed fields are merged with an optional raw "query" (TestResultsFilterApiModel) for advanced fields.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: set_test_result
tools.description: Change selected fields of a test result (JSON Patch) without touching the others. To change the result status use statusCode (patching outcome is ignored by TestIT). Raw RFC 6902 operations can be added via "operations".

statusCode.description: Status code, e.g. PASSED, FAILED, BLOCKED, SKIPPED (see test statuses).

operations.description: Extra JSON Patch operations [{op, path, value}].

tools.name: update_test_result
tools.description: Replace a test result (PUT). WARNING: this is a full replacement — fields not sent (comment, message, links, step results...) are cleared. Prefer set_test_result for partial changes.

payload.description: Raw TestResultUpdateV2Request fields; typed args take precedence.

tools.name: submit_test_run_results
tools.description: Send autotest results into a test run (POST /testRuns/{id}/testResults). Each result needs an existing autotest externalId and a configurationId. Returns created test result IDs.

tools.name: list_test_plans
tools.description: List test plans for a project.

tools.name: get_test_plan
tools.description: Get a test plan by ID.

tools.name: create_test_plan
tools.description: Create a test plan (status New). Extra CreateTestPlanApiModel fields can be passed in "payload".

tools.name: update_test_plan
tools.description: Replace a test plan (PUT). Requires id, name, projectId in payload; fields not sent are cleared.

tools.name: set_test_plan_state
tools.description: Change test plan status: start (-> InProgress), pause (-> Paused), complete (-> Completed).

tools.name: create_test_plan_clone
tools.description: Clone a test plan (copy named "<name> (1)", status New). Returns the new plan.

tools.name: list_test_plan_test_runs
tools.description: List test runs of a test plan, optionally filtered by state.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: delete_test_plan
tools.description: Delete (archive) a test plan. Use restore_test_plan to undo or purge_test_plan to remove it for good.

tools.name: restore_test_plan
tools.description: Restore an archived (deleted) test plan.

tools.name: purge_test_plan
tools.description: Permanently delete an archived test plan. Irreversible; delete (archive) it first.

tools.name: list_test_plan_test_suites
tools.description: Get the test suite tree of a test plan (suites with nested children).

tools.name: get_test_suite
tools.description: Get a test suite by ID.

tools.name: create_test_suite
tools.description: Create a test suite in a test plan (top-level, or nested under parentId). Then fill it with set_test_suite_work_items.

parentId.description: Parent suite UUID for a nested suite.

tools.name: set_test_suite_work_items
tools.description: Set the work items of a test suite. REPLACES the current list; test points are created for each work item x suite configuration (the default configuration if none set).

tools.name: set_test_suite_configurations
tools.description: Set the configurations of a test suite (replaces the current list).

tools.name: list_test_suite_test_points
tools.description: List test points of a test suite (work item x configuration, with status and tester).

tools.name: search_test_points
tools.description: Search test points across test plans/suites. Typed fields are merged with an optional raw "filter" (TestPointFilterRequestModel).

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: delete_test_suite
tools.description: Delete a test suite with its nested suites and test points.

tools.name: search_autotests
tools.description: Search autotests. Typed fields are merged over an optional raw "filter" (AutoTestFilterApiModel). projectIds defaults to the current project.

isDeleted.description: Default false (active only). true = archived autotests.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_autotest
tools.description: Get an autotest by UUID.

tools.name: create_autotest
tools.description: Create an autotest. Linking it to test cases (workItemIds) makes those cases automated, which is required to create test runs from a test plan. Results are later sent by externalId (submit_test_run_results). Extra AutoTestCreateApiModel fields can go into "payload".

externalId.description: Stable ID of the test in your code, unique per project.

workItemIds.description: Work item UUIDs to link the autotest with.

tools.name: delete_autotest
tools.description: Delete (archive) an autotest. Archived autotests return 404 from get_autotest and can only be found via search_autotests with isDeleted=true; the API has no restore or purge for autotests.

tools.name: list_autotest_work_items
tools.description: List work items (test cases) linked to an autotest.

tools.name: link_autotest_work_item
tools.description: Link an autotest to a work item; the work item becomes automated.

tools.name: unlink_autotest_work_item
tools.description: Remove the link between an autotest and a work item.

tools.name: get_project_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for all test plans in a project.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_test_plan_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for a specific test plan.

tools.name: get_test_run_statistics
tools.description: Get test result statistics for a specific test run, optionally filtered.

filter.description: Optional filter body to narrow statistics results.

tools.name: list_shared_steps
tools.description: List shared steps of a project, with optional filters.

name.description: Filter by (part of) work item name.

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.description: Get a shared step by ID.

tools.description: List configurations for a project.

tools.description: Get a configuration by ID.

tools.description: Create a new configuration.
